name: ambiguous-agent
description: Ambiguous Workspace integration for a provisioned AI coworker. Same workspace surface as the ambiguous plugin — docs, sheets, slides, wiki pages, tasks, CRM records, calendar events, mail, chat and Drive files — but acts as the agent's own identity rather than as you, using its ak_ API key. Requires a key from Admin → People & Access → New agent; install fails without one.

apiToken.title: Agent API key
apiToken.description: The agent's ak_… key, shown once when it was provisioned. AMBI_API_TOKEN in the environment overrides it.
